name: De Leonism
summary: De Leonism, the doctrine of Daniel De Leon and the Socialist Labor Party of America, holds that workers must organize in revolutionary industrial unions while also building a socialist party to win the ballot and declare the capitalist state dissolved. Power would then pass to an All-Industrial Congress of delegates chosen by industry and recallable at any time, which replaces territorial government and eventually leaves no political state. It rejects reformism, craft unionism and vanguard parties, and is held to be impossibilist, majoritarian and anti-Leninist.
scope: The mature De Leon program (c. 1890-1914) as set out in Reform or Revolution (1896) and Socialist Reconstruction of Society (1905), plus the continuing SLP of America. Excludes the later IWW, general syndicalism and Leninist communism, which De Leonists distinguish themselves from. Many statements on modern issues are inferred from general Marxist principles.

sources.title: De Leonism
sources.author: Wikipedia
sources.usedFor: Overview: dual organization, All-Industrial Congress, recall, contrast with Leninism and syndicalism, state-capitalist view of the USSR.

universal-healthcare.rationale: Not addressed; De Leon dismissed palliative reforms yet an adherent would accept that a socialist industrial government supplies health care, so mild agreement is inferred.

raise-minimum-wage.rationale: De Leon argued that wage gains are illusory and reforms within the wage system are a cat's paw, so an adherent would not campaign for a higher minimum wage; inferred.

markets-allocate-better.rationale: Capitalist production is described as anarchic, and De Leon wanted planned production administered by industrial bodies instead.

public-ownership.rationale: Social ownership of the means of production is the goal, though De Leon warned that mere state ownership of railroads leaves wage labor intact; ownership by the whole industrial union.

tax-the-wealthy.rationale: Taxing the rich is a reform that leaves capitalism intact; an adherent would see it as a palliative rather than a goal, inferred.

unions-good.rationale: Industrial unions are the core of the program, but De Leon denounced craft unions and labor fakirs, so support is for revolutionary industrial unionism specifically.

property-fundamental.rationale: Capitalist private ownership of the tools of production is the root of class rule and must be abolished.

regulate-corporations.rationale: Regulation is a reform of externals that leaves the wage system in place; an adherent would call it futile rather than harmful, inferred.

cut-welfare.rationale: Never a focus; adherents oppose capitalist cuts but see welfare as a palliative, so mild disagreement is inferred.

worker-ownership.rationale: Workers organized in industrial unions are to own and run production collectively, the central aim of the Socialist Industrial Union program.

surveillance-ok.rationale: De Leon described the capitalist state as an instrument of suppression, so adherents would distrust state surveillance; inferred, anachronistic.

legalize-drugs.rationale: The question was outside the program and adherents had no settled view; split or indifferent.

restrict-hate-speech.rationale: The capitalist state is a class instrument and would use such powers against labor; inferred, anachronistic.

strong-leader.rationale: De Leonism stresses majority self-organization and decentralized industrial government with recallable representatives, against dictatorship by a leader.

state-harmful.rationale: The political state is to be abolished and replaced by administration of industry, but De Leon's workers' government is a state-like body in the transition, so agreement is not strong.

limit-guns.rationale: Not addressed; De Leon's position on arms in the revolution rested on the ballot backed by organization, not on gun policy.

empower-police-military.rationale: The police and military are part of the capitalist state's apparatus of suppression and oppression, so an adherent would oppose strengthening them.

legalize-sex-work.rationale: Not addressed; adherents likely view prostitution as a product of capitalism but with no program stance on law.

decide-locally.rationale: Representation is to be by industry regardless of old political boundaries, and a central industrial administration plans production nationally, though without territorial centralism.

rehabilitation.rationale: Not addressed; adherents hold crime flows from class society, so mild support for rehabilitation is inferred.

traditional-family.rationale: Not a program issue; Marxist view that institutions reflect class society makes adherents unlikely to treat the traditional family as foundational; inferred.

same-sex-marriage.rationale: Anachronistic and absent from the program; adherents are split or indifferent.

abortion-legal.rationale: Not part of the program; the tendency left it as a matter outside its economic and industrial focus.

correct-racial-injustice.rationale: The SLP held that class unity solves such issues and rejected special measures, but opposed discrimination; adherents split or indifferent on active correction.

gender-social-construct.rationale: Not addressed in the sources; no settled stance.

preserve-national-culture.rationale: Internationalist Marxist orientation makes preserving national culture a non-priority; inferred.

gradual-change.rationale: De Leon contrasted reform with revolution and demanded unconditional surrender of the capitalist system rather than piecemeal change.

reduce-immigration.rationale: A working class united across borders is the premise; adherents oppose restriction on class grounds, inferred.

empower-international-orgs.rationale: Internationalist but De Leon was hostile to the Second International majority and to bureaucratic bodies; split.

free-trade.rationale: Not addressed; capitalist trade policy debates were treated as disputes within the capitalist class, so mild disagreement inferred.

nation-first.rationale: Working class is international; adherents reject nationalism and capitalist great-power rivalry.

humanitarian-intervention.rationale: Capitalist wars are seen as imperialist; adherents would distrust intervention, inferred.

open-borders.rationale: Internationalism points that way, but De Leon addressed no immigration policy; inferred.

limit-growth.rationale: Anachronistic; De Leon expected socialist production to expand output, so growth limits are unlikely to be endorsed.

tech-solves-problems.rationale: Marxist view that technological productive power would serve all once freed from capitalist ownership; inferred.

revolution-justified.rationale: De Leon explicitly says revolution is the goal and that whether it is peaceful or bloody cuts no figure.

experts-over-public.rationale: Governance is by delegates elected from industrial unions subject to recall, not by an expert class.

central-planning.rationale: Industrial government plans production through a central administration, though organized by industry democratically rather than by a state apparatus.

socialized-markets.rationale: The aim is abolition of the wage system and production for use; market exchange among worker-owned firms is not the program.

land-value-tax.rationale: Land tax schemes are reforms that leave capitalism intact and De Leon dismissed such panaceas.

tax-inheritance.rationale: A reform within capitalism, though adherents would not oppose it; mild disagreement as a program focus is inferred.

basic-income.rationale: A palliative within the wage system; inferred as De Leon never addressed it.

tariffs-protect-industry.rationale: Protectionism is a quarrel among capitalists and not a labor program; inferred.

state-directs-investment.rationale: Investment would be directed by the industrial government, not by a capitalist state; split on the literal statement.

widespread-small-property.rationale: Socialism means collective ownership of production tools, and De Leon rejected small-owner schemes.

abolish-money-wages.rationale: Revolution means abolishing the wage system, with workers receiving the full product of their labor.

abolish-central-banks.rationale: Not a program item and the market-money solution is foreign to it; inferred.

corporatist-bargaining.rationale: De Leon rejected class collaboration and state-recognized bargaining as ways to bind unions to employers.

one-party-rule.rationale: De Leonists reject the vanguard party and criticize Leninist one-party states; the party was meant to wither away.

monarchy-legitimate.rationale: A hereditary head of state is incompatible with the democratic working-class government; inferred from Marxist republicanism.

democracy-best.rationale: The program rests on majority support and elections, but De Leon saw bourgeois democracy as limited and favored industrial representation.

direct-votes.rationale: De Leon criticized the referendum as a reformist device; split on direct legislation.

workers-councils.rationale: Power passes to an All-Industrial Congress of delegates from industrial unions, which is close to this proposal.

right-to-secede.rationale: The opened sources never address secession, and adherents treat the national question as secondary to class, so no position is stated.

natural-rulers.rationale: Socialism ends class rule and delegates are recallable by the workers.

political-violence-never.rationale: De Leon said peaceful or bloody means cuts no figure, and held that organized power must enforce the vote; not pacifist but he preferred the ballot.

war-builds-character.rationale: Capitalist wars were opposed by De Leonists as imperialist.

separate-church-state.rationale: As a Marxist party it wanted religion kept out of politics; the sources opened do not detail this.

laws-from-scripture.rationale: Marxist materialism and secular working-class government make this contrary to the program.

private-courts-defense.rationale: Capitalist class power in legal and defense functions is what the revolution overthrows.

military-superiority.rationale: Adherents oppose capitalist militarism and imperialist rivalry.

ethnic-nation.rationale: The class-based internationalism of De Leonism rejects ethnic nationalism.

class-struggle-history.rationale: De Leon presents society as a conflict between the propertied capitalist class and the propertyless proletariat.

equal-outcomes.rationale: Full product to the worker and abolition of class rule imply material equality, though De Leon did not speak of equal outcomes.

indigenous-land-authority.rationale: Land rights of indigenous peoples are outside De Leon's texts; the program concerns workers' ownership of industry, so no position is stated.

civilizational-union.rationale: Working-class unity across nations is the premise, not civilization blocs.

self-interest-moral.rationale: The tendency condemns capitalist profit-seeking and favors collective ends; inferred.

duties-before-rights.rationale: Not addressed; individual liberty under industrial democracy is not subordinated in the sources.

limit-population.rationale: Marxists reject population explanations of poverty; inferred.

industrial-civilization-disaster.rationale: Industrial production is the material base of socialism in De Leon's scheme.

accelerate-technology.rationale: Marxist expectation that technique matures toward socialism; inferred.

human-enhancement.rationale: An anachronistic question that De Leon and the SLP never discussed, so no position can be inferred from principle.

algorithmic-government.rationale: Anachronistic; government by recallable elected delegates is the model.

unbreakable-encryption.rationale: An anachronistic question with no basis in the program; adherents have no settled view.

restore-past-order.rationale: Revolution looks forward to socialism, and De Leon mocked restoration as in the Wat Tyler example.

results-over-ideology.rationale: Scientific socialism is treated as a doctrine; De Leon rejected pragmatic reformism.

direct-action.rationale: De Leonism requires political action alongside industrial action and rejects pure syndicalism; the ballot is the destructive weapon.

means-match-ends.rationale: Industrial unions are built as the framework of the future government, so the organization prefigures the society.

return-to-foraging.rationale: Contradicts the program of industrial production under worker control.

abolish-division-of-labor.rationale: Industrial organization by industries presupposes functional division of labor; De Leon did not call for its abolition.

distribute-by-need.rationale: De Leon stressed workers receiving the full product; the needs principle is not stated in the sources, so inferred.

production-for-use.rationale: De Leon contrasts capitalist anarchy of production for profit with planned socialist production for the community.

profit-exploitation.rationale: Wages are the part of product returned to the worker and the remainder is taken as profit.

dictatorship-of-proletariat.rationale: The workers' industrial government rules but De Leon stressed the ballot and a majority, and disliked Leninist dictatorship; split on wording.

collective-farming.rationale: Not addressed in the sources; farm workers were to be industrially organized but details unspecified.

capitalism-causes-war.rationale: Marxist-consistent, De Leonists criticized capitalist wars, but the opened sources do not state it.

taxation-theft.rationale: Socialists reject the libertarian premise; industrial government funds itself from collective production.

harm-principle.rationale: Liberal theory of limits on state power was not taken up in the sources opened, and adherents hold the state is a class tool anyway, leaving this neutral.

conscription.rationale: Anti-militarist but no stated position; inferred.

exit-over-voice.rationale: The vote and workplace-based industrial franchise are central.

state-as-business.rationale: Government is to administer production for the community, not serve customers; adherents reject capitalist models.

positive-liberty.rationale: Economic freedom through ownership of the means of production is the premise of the program.

media-academia-power.rationale: De Leon located power in capitalist ownership, not in media and universities; inferred.

hereditarian-race.rationale: Marxist class analysis rejects racial biology.

organic-representation.rationale: Representation by industry resembles trade bodies but is socialist and replaces parties only after the revolution.

total-state.rationale: The political state is to disappear.

national-rebirth.rationale: Nationalist rebirth is alien to class internationalism.

personal-loyalty-rule.rationale: Representatives are elected and recallable under industrial democracy.

bound-labor.rationale: Opposed to compulsion of labor and wage slavery alike.

no-neutral-knowledge.rationale: Epistemology of power and knowledge is not discussed in De Leon's texts, so no stated position exists.

universal-morality.rationale: Marxist tendency to view morality as class-conditioned, yet De Leon used appeals to right; split.

single-common-good.rationale: De Leon denied common interests between classes but the socialist society is classless; inferred.

diaspora-return-right.rationale: Diaspora and homeland claims are not part of the class-centered program, and no source opened addresses them.

workplace-democracy.rationale: Industrial unions run production and elect delegates.

school-vouchers.rationale: Not addressed; privatization runs against the program.

avoid-deficit-stimulus.rationale: Fiscal policy within capitalism is outside the program; De Leon treated such management as a palliative, so no position is taken.

economic-freedom.rationale: Capitalist economic freedom is seen as wage slavery; inferred.

rule-by-example.rationale: Confucian-style moral rule is alien; the program is organized power.

national-self-determination.rationale: Nationalist questions are not treated in the sources opened; the tendency is class-first, so adherents have no settled stance.

reason-over-faith.rationale: Marxist scientific socialism, but religion was not a key subject in the opened sources.

class-collaboration.rationale: De Leon spurned "Peace, peace, where there is no peace" and held classes are irreconcilable.

dominated-front.rationale: Third-world fronts against the West are a later idea that the sources opened do not touch; neutral.

workers-nation.rationale: De Leonism is internationalist and class-based.

distinct-gender-roles.rationale: The SLP favored equal rights for women; inferred.

ban-interest.rationale: The target is the wage system and capital as a whole, not interest as such.

racial-segregation-law.rationale: Class unity across races is core.

state-class-instrument.rationale: De Leon calls the political state a tool of capitalist class rule.

expand-fossil-fuels.rationale: Energy policy is anachronistic for De Leon, so no position can be inferred from the program.

assimilate-immigrants.rationale: Not addressed; the class-internationalist premise mildly disfavors demanding cultural assimilation, so slight disagreement is inferred.

elite-replacement.rationale: Conspiracy theory alien to the class analysis.

proportional-representation.rationale: Geographic representation of parties is replaced by representation by industry.

patriarchy-structural.rationale: Not addressed; the class analysis is central.

political-elite-corrupt.rationale: De Leon warned that labor politicians compromise in office, a related claim.

security-forces-accountable.rationale: Transitional justice for state forces is not addressed in the sources, so no position is stated.

equal-moral-worth.rationale: Basis of the demand for abolition of class rule.

socialism-one-country.rationale: Not stated; the tendency calls Soviet Russia state capitalist but did not specify this.

settler-state-colonial.rationale: Settler colonialism as a framework is not discussed in De Leon's work or the overview opened, leaving no stated position.

uniform-civil-code.rationale: Equal law for all workers; inferred.

restrict-conversion.rationale: Inferred from civil liberties of workers.

ban-cattle-slaughter.rationale: A religious-cultural measure alien to the program, which would regard it as an infringement; inferred from secular outlook.

state-strengthens-encirclement.rationale: De Leonists decentralize and expect the state to fade away.

consent-of-governed.rationale: Rests on majority ballot and industrial vote.

trade-surplus.rationale: Mercantilism is a capitalist rivalry; inferred.

initiating-force-wrong.rationale: De Leon held the ballot ideal but force may be used to enforce it and the capitalist state is itself force; not a libertarian.

competition-drives-progress.rationale: Class struggle, not social darwinist competition, is the motor.

ban-extremist-parties.rationale: A revolutionary party would be a target; inferred.

freedom-as-non-domination.rationale: Wage dependence is treated as domination; inferred.

separated-powers.rationale: The government is a single industrial congress.

vanguard-party.rationale: De Leonism relies on majority support, explicitly unlike Leninism.

priority-to-poor.rationale: Working class interests, but not framed as poor-first.

right-to-buy-council-homes.rationale: Housing tenure reforms are palliatives within capitalism never discussed by De Leon, so no position is stated.

restrict-strikes-picketing.rationale: Union power is the means of revolution.

population-causes-poverty.rationale: Poverty comes from capitalist exploitation of wage labor.

offices-by-lottery.rationale: Elections and recall are the mechanism.

emergency-suspend-protections.rationale: Adherents see the capitalist state as a tool of suppression and would oppose it gaining such powers; inferred.

price-controls-essentials.rationale: Price control is a reform within the wage system and was not discussed in the sources opened, so no position is stated.

long-naturalization-wait.rationale: Immigration rules are not addressed; class internationalism implies mild opposition to long waits, inferred.

representatives-worker-pay.rationale: Recallable delegates from the workers; pay not addressed.

party-discipline-binding.rationale: The SLP was strictly disciplined, a critique commonly made.

pool-sovereignty.rationale: The sources opened do not discuss supranational unions such as the EU, and adherents are split between internationalism and hostility to capitalist blocs.

head-commands-forces.rationale: Executive command of the forces contradicts rule by recallable industrial delegates, so adherents would reject it; inferred.

church-by-bishops.rationale: Church governance is unrelated to the program and no source opened addresses it, so it is left neutral.

defeat-own-government-war.rationale: Not stated in the opened sources.

censor-art-for-virtue.rationale: Moral censorship is not discussed; the working-class program favors free expression, so mild disagreement is inferred.

unlimited-reelection.rationale: Recall at any time is the rule.

recall-officials.rationale: Representatives are subject to recall at any time.

end-foreign-alliances.rationale: Capitalist military alliances are opposed in principle, but no source opened states a position on ending them, so neutral.

abolish-rental-housing.rationale: Housing tenure policy is not in the program; De Leonists abolish capitalist ownership of production, not rental per se.

people-in-arms.rationale: De Leon relied on the ballot backed by industrial organization rather than arms, and the militia idea is not addressed, so neutral.

rural-life-healthier.rationale: A romantic moral claim about rural life is not part of the industrial program; mild disagreement inferred.

reunify-divided-nation.rationale: National reunification is not discussed in the sources opened, so no position is stated.

educated-out-of-touch.rationale: A populist anti-intellectual claim not found in De Leon, who was a Columbia-trained intellectual; mild disagreement inferred.

cultures-equal-different.rationale: A cultural-relativist claim not discussed; internationalism and equal worth suggest mild agreement, inferred.

death-penalty.rationale: Not discussed in the sources opened; socialists generally oppose capital punishment, so mild disagreement is inferred.

more-religion-public.rationale: A secular Marxist tendency would see a larger public religious role as foreign to the program; the opened sources say little on religion, so inferred.

sex-ed-in-schools.rationale: Not addressed in any source opened; no settled adherent view.

creationism-in-schools.rationale: A materialist scientific socialism would reject it; inferred as nothing stated.

restrict-pornography.rationale: Not addressed; adherents split or indifferent.

citizenship-by-descent.rationale: Class internationalism suggests rejecting descent-based citizenship; inferred.

minority-language-support.rationale: Language policy is not part of the program and no source opened addresses it, so no stated position.

religious-exemptions.rationale: Not discussed in the sources opened; adherents are not known to have a settled view on exemptions.

encourage-eccentricity.rationale: A liberal view on social conformity that De Leon's texts do not touch, leaving no position.

sovereign-debt-cancellation.rationale: Not addressed; anti-capitalist but no stated position.

independence-needs-economic-change.rationale: Follows from De Leon's view that political change without altering the wage system leaves the poodle a poodle; applied to independence by inference.

constituent-assembly.rationale: The new government is to be built from industrial unions, not an assembly of territorial constituencies; inferred.

restrict-freedoms-for-growth.rationale: De Leonists criticize authoritarian development states as state capitalism and stress majority democracy.

rich-countries-aid-poor.rationale: International aid is not discussed; adherents oppose imperialism but did not frame duties of aid, so neutral.

direct-election-head-of-state.rationale: There is no presidency in the industrial government; inferred.

central-bank-independence.rationale: Control of money by capitalist institutions is opposed; inferred.

no-land-for-peace.rationale: Nationalist claims to land are alien to the program; inferred.

property-serves-common-good.rationale: De Leon's answer would be stronger, abolition of capitalist property; mild agreement as the weaker claim.

soviet-state-capitalist.rationale: The Wikipedia account says De Leonism considers the Soviet Union and China state capitalist.

precautionary-principle.rationale: An anachronistic environmental principle with no basis in the sources, leaving no position.

collective-defense.rationale: Opposed to capitalist military alliances; inferred.

annexed-territory-occupation.rationale: Not discussed in the sources opened, so no stated position exists.

subordinate-church-to-state.rationale: Not discussed in the sources opened; adherents are split between secularism and noninterference with belief.

nonpartisan-head-of-state.rationale: No head of state in industrial government; inferred.

region-keeps-system.rationale: Special-region arrangements are outside the program and no source addresses them.

sacred-ruler.rationale: Contradicts the rejection of class rule and hereditary power.

flat-income-tax.rationale: A tax reform within capitalism; the regressive aspect would be disliked; inferred.

character-from-environment.rationale: Marxist environmentalism of social being; not stated explicitly in the sources opened.

sovereign-above-law.rationale: Recallable delegates; no ruler above the workers' will.

space-expansion.rationale: Anachronistic for De Leon; no position can be inferred.

mixed-constitution.rationale: The industrial government is rule by the working class as a whole, not mixed.

leader-cult.rationale: De Leonists criticize Leninist personality cults and hold recallable delegates.

equal-parenting.rationale: Family law is not discussed in the sources opened, so no position is stated.

class-struggle-under-socialism.rationale: De Leonism holds that classes end with the socialist industrial union, so this claim of continued struggle is a Maoist one.

land-redistribution.rationale: Socialism aims at collective rather than individual farm ownership; the distinction makes this literal claim unclear.

refugee-return.rationale: Refugee return is outside De Leon's concerns and the sources opened, so no stated position.

co-ethnic-territorial-claim.rationale: Nationalist irredentism is rejected by class internationalism.

apostasy-punishable.rationale: Contrary to secular Marxism and civil liberties; inferred.

women-must-cover.rationale: Inferred from secular and egalitarian commitments.

common-currency.rationale: Monetary union is not discussed; capitalist currency arrangements are a matter among capitalists in the program, so neutral.

national-cultural-autonomy.rationale: The national question is not addressed in the sources opened, so no position can be stated.

rights-where-you-live.rationale: Class struggle where workers live, not Zionism; inferred.

material-conditions-drive-history.rationale: De Leon treats the system of production as determinant of class structure and the state, in the Marxist way.

ban-cartels.rationale: Trust-busting is a reform of the externals of capitalism, though De Leon saw trusts as preparing socialism.

no-bailouts.rationale: Capitalist rescue of firms is not discussed by De Leon; adherents would not defend either side, leaving neutral.

courts-bound-by-majority.rationale: Elections and majorities decide; courts are part of the class state; inferred.

gender-parity-bodies.rationale: Quotas are not addressed in the sources opened; the program is class-focused, so no position.

economic-self-sufficiency.rationale: Capitalist imperialism is opposed and internationalism is central.

trade-labor-env-standards.rationale: Not addressed; a reform within capitalism.

moral-incentives.rationale: Not addressed; De Leon envisaged workers receiving full product.

armed-group-creates-revolution.rationale: De Leonism relies on majority support and organization, rejecting vanguardism.

abolish-hereditary-privilege.rationale: Class privilege is the target of the revolution; hereditary titles inferred.

end-racial-preferences.rationale: Not addressed; class-unity stance but no position.

public-money-creation.rationale: Monetary reform is not addressed; De Leon dismissed currency panaceas but did not discuss public issuance, so neutral.

capitalism-adapts.rationale: De Leon expected capitalism to produce its own downfall but did not predict automatic collapse; he stressed organized revolution.

delink-world-market.rationale: Dependency theory is not addressed in the sources opened, leaving no stated position.

labor-aristocracy.rationale: De Leon argued workers are exploited and attacked labor fakirs; the thesis of rich-world workers sharing imperial spoils is not stated.

freedom-to-discriminate.rationale: Class unity and equal rights of workers; inferred.

entrenched-bill-of-rights.rationale: Constitutions of the capitalist state are to be replaced; inferred.

colonial-treaties-void.rationale: Not addressed in the sources opened; no stated position.

parliament-supreme.rationale: Parliaments of territorial constituencies are to be replaced by an industrial congress.

animal-suffering-matters.rationale: Animal ethics is anachronistic here and absent from the sources, so no position can be inferred.

animal-use-humane.rationale: Anachronistic and not discussed, so no position is inferred.

noblesse-oblige.rationale: Rejects benevolent paternalism of a ruling class; class struggle is the answer.

withdraw-from-politics.rationale: Political action is a defining obligation of the movement.

ruling-class-consent.rationale: De Leon highlighted capitalist state force and labor fakirs; culture-based consent is not addressed.

world-economy-extracts-surplus.rationale: Theories of unequal exchange appear later than De Leon and are not in the sources opened, so neutral.

native-born-offices.rationale: Nativism is alien to class internationalism.

party-own-road.rationale: De Leonists criticized Moscow direction, so independence of national parties is inferred.

self-reliance-over-aid.rationale: Development strategy for poor countries is not addressed in the sources opened, so no position.

antifascism-founding-value.rationale: Anti-fascism as a constitutional principle is anachronistic for De Leon's period and absent from the sources opened.

totalitarianisms-equivalent.rationale: De Leonists criticize Soviet state capitalism but defend socialism, so split.

slavery-not-civil-war-cause.rationale: Marxist reading would stress slavery as the cause; not stated.

preserve-contested-monuments.rationale: Not addressed in the sources opened; no stated position.

male-disadvantage-attention.rationale: Not addressed in the sources opened; no position can be inferred from the program.

domestic-violence-symmetry.rationale: Not addressed in the sources opened; no stated position.

military-guardian-role.rationale: The military is an instrument of capitalist suppression.

paid-care-work.rationale: Domestic labor debates are not in De Leon's texts as opened, leaving no position.

filial-duty.rationale: Family obligations are not discussed in the sources opened, so no stated position.

office-by-exam.rationale: Officials are elected and recallable delegates.

no-fault-divorce.rationale: Divorce law is not discussed in the sources opened, so no position is stated.

recallable-delegates.rationale: Representatives in the All-Industrial Congress are subject to recall at any time.

individual-pension-accounts.rationale: Privatized savings accounts run against collective ownership; inferred.

land-use-tenure.rationale: Social ownership of land is implied but not detailed.

budget-needs-parliament.rationale: Not addressed; parliamentary forms are replaced.

foreign-land-ownership.rationale: Not addressed; economic nationalism conflicts with internationalism, so mild disagreement is inferred.

disparate-impact-discrimination.rationale: A modern legal doctrine absent from the sources opened, so no position can be stated.

consumerism-harmful.rationale: Not addressed in the sources opened; adherents criticize capitalism but did not frame consumption, so neutral.

intervene-in-bloc.rationale: De Leonism criticizes Soviet imperial control as state capitalism.

corporate-influence.rationale: The state is a tool of the capitalist class; labor politicians' compromise noted.

restrict-foreign-funding.rationale: Not addressed; adherents distrust the capitalist state's powers and nationalism, so mild disagreement is inferred.

pronatalist-incentives.rationale: Population policy is not addressed; adherents reject population explanations of poverty, so mild disagreement is inferred.

residents-only-property.rationale: Local property restrictions are outside the program and no source opened addresses them.

job-guarantee.rationale: Full employment implicit in industrial administration; a palliative under capitalism.

democratic-peace.rationale: A political-science claim not discussed in the sources opened; adherents see capitalist democracies as imperialist, leaving neutral.

no-duty-to-obey.rationale: Not addressed; De Leon accepted the ballot but denied the capitalist state's legitimacy.

industrial-unions.rationale: De Leon held that craft unionism means impotence and that the workers' constituent bodies must be exclusively industrial.

non-intervention.rationale: Not addressed; De Leon's internationalist working-class solidarity cuts against an absolute rule, though he opposed capitalist wars. Inferred from general Marxist principles.

minority-conspiracy.rationale: De Leon located conflict in class struggle between workers and capitalists, not in plots by ethnic or religious minorities, and the SLP stood for working-class unity across such lines.

abolish-legal-marriage.rationale: Not addressed in the sources; the programme focuses on class and industry, and no abolition of legal marriage is documented. Inferred from the economic focus.

public-access-to-information.rationale: Not addressed; an industrial government of recallable delegates would be accountable to workers, from which openness is inferred.

local-production.rationale: De Leon's programme organises production by industry on a national scale through an All-Industrial Congress, not by locality; inferred from that.

informal-organisation.rationale: De Leon insisted on disciplined, organised dual organisation: a revolutionary industrial union plus a socialist party, which excludes small informal groups.

national-law-over-international.rationale: Not addressed; the programme dissolves the political state and territorial government, so the question of precedence has no clear answer.

religious-nation.rationale: De Leon's Marxism treats the working class as an international class and rejects religion as a basis of social organisation, so belonging is not defined by faith.

deference-to-leading-power.rationale: Not addressed directly; inferred from De Leon's Marxist opposition to imperialism and ruling-class power.

regional-revenue-retention.rationale: De Leon's industrial government is organised nationally by industry, so regional fiscal autonomy is not part of it; inferred.

personal-possessions-private.rationale: The Marxist distinction De Leon inherits is that socialism socialises the means of production, not personal belongings.

defeat-communism.rationale: De Leonists reject Leninism but see socialism as the goal, so they would not join a campaign to defeat communism; inferred.

mixed-public-service-providers.rationale: Services would be run by the industrial government with no private providers; inferred from the All-Industrial Congress model.

religion-illusion.rationale: Marxist materialism treats religion as a product of class society; inferred, as De Leon's cited texts do not address it directly.

capitalism-progressive.rationale: De Leon followed Marx in holding that capitalism developed the productive forces that make socialism possible.

women-equality-needs-economic-change.rationale: Marxist tradition ties women's emancipation to ending wage-slavery; inferred, not addressed in the cited texts.

socialized-care.rationale: A socialist industrial government would provide such services; inferred from general Marxist principles.

purge-loanwords.rationale: Not addressed; inferred internationalist Marxist indifference to linguistic purity.

treaties-binding.rationale: Not addressed; an adherent would likely treat treaty questions as secondary to class struggle, inferred.

cooperative-communities.rationale: De Leon proposed centralised industry-wide organisation, not small property-holding communities; inferred.

majority-settlement.rationale: Inferred from class-based internationalism that rejects ethnic politics.

neither-capitalism-nor-communism.rationale: De Leonism is itself a socialist programme and does not claim a third course between capitalism and socialism; inferred.

historical-land-claim.rationale: De Leonism is internationalist and class-based and gives no weight to historical land claims; inferred.

holocaust-denial.rationale: A 19th-century Marxist doctrine that never addressed this; no adherent would accept denial, inferred.

criminalize-homosexuality.rationale: Not addressed; De Leon's class focus gives no support to criminalising private sexual conduct, inferred.

suppress-opposition.rationale: De Leon's strategy is to win the ballot and organise openly, so he opposed suppression, though he stressed dissolving the capitalist state; inferred.

punish-blasphemy.rationale: Not addressed; adherents treated religion as a private matter outside government, inferred from Marxist materialism.

colonies-serve-metropole.rationale: De Leon opposed capitalist exploitation and imperial rule; inferred from his class-struggle analysis.

defensive-jihad-duty.rationale: Not addressed; De Leonism is a secular Marxist doctrine and inferred to reject religious-duty claims.

unreligious-rulers-fought.rationale: Government is to be by the industrial congress of workers' delegates, not religious law; inferred.

participatory-democracy.rationale: The All-Industrial Congress of recallable delegates chosen by industry is workplace self-government replacing territorial officials.

intersecting-oppressions.rationale: De Leon held class struggle to be the central fact but did not address race or sex oppression; adherents split, inferred.

gender-identity-recognition.rationale: Not addressed; an adherent would favour equal legal protection as a matter of workers' equality, inferred.

assisted-dying.rationale: Not addressed by De Leon; adherents' views are unrecorded.

left-right-obsolete.rationale: De Leon insisted on the irreconcilable class struggle, so a combination of left and right ideas is rejected; inferred.

alienated-labor.rationale: De Leon described wage labour as the sale of workers' product to employers for profit, which fits alienation though he did not use that term.

islam-incompatible.rationale: Not addressed; class-based doctrine gives no support to cultural-civilisation claims, inferred.

divine-source-of-authority.rationale: A materialist Marxist doctrine places authority in the working class; inferred.

religious-dress-in-state.rationale: Not addressed; an adherent would keep religion out of state institutions, inferred from secular Marxism.

ban-nda-harassment.rationale: De Leon dismissed reform within the wage system as palliative, yet adherents would not oppose such protection; inferred.

social-market-economy.rationale: Reform or Revolution rejects patching capitalism with reforms and calls for abolishing it, which includes a regulated market economy.

abolish-armed-forces.rationale: De Leonism envisages a state-less industrial government and opposes war, but defence arrangements go unaddressed; inferred.

rich-first.rationale: Treating inequality as stages is the kind of gradualism De Leon rejected; inferred.

stay-neutral-between-blocs.rationale: As an internationalist working-class doctrine it opposed capitalist wars among great powers; inferred.

missingStatements.text: Workers should be organized in unions by industry rather than by craft.
missingStatements.rationale: De Leon held that craft unionism means impotence and that the workers' constituent bodies must be exclusively industrial.

missingStatements.text: Workers should pursue socialism through both a political party and workplace organization together, neither alone.
missingStatements.rationale: De Leonism's dual organization requires the ballot and industrial union power, with each insufficient alone.
missingStatements.declined: Follows from the answers to direct-action, unions-good and workers-councils; a dual party-and-union strategy is specific to De Leonism and syndicalist debates.

notes: Statements on modern social, environmental and technology questions are inferred. The Wikipedia source did not cover religion, nationalism or violence, and the primary texts opened did not address them directly, so those answers are low confidence.
